_comment: Which event the previz builds and drives.
This exists so the one-command path stays one command. go.py used to
call build_level.main() with no argument, which hardwired the documented
workflow to despacio even though every function it called had taken an
event since the day it was written.
Overridden by COSMOS_EVENT in the environment, and by an explicit
--event. The environment wins over this file on purpose: this is what
the repo is set up for, the variable is one person looking at something
else for ten minutes, and that should not need a tracked file edited.
